title: Capitana: First Lunar Base
dataMode: Embedded historical record, verified 2026-11-15. Not live telemetry.

solarEvent.interpretation: A real solar energetic particle event recorded by DONKI. The mission replays this date as a training prompt. The record does not measure a lunar astronaut's dose and does not predict exposure at the lunar base.

scienceCards.fact: No location on the Moon stays continuously illuminated. Three points on the rim of Shackleton crater remain collectively sunlit for more than 90% of the year.
scienceCards.boundary: This is not a promise of continuous power at one base location. Game resource changes are educational simplifications.

scienceCards.fact: Enclosed spacecraft rely on carbon dioxide removal equipment. Removing CO2 is a different task from supplying oxygen.
scienceCards.boundary: No medical prediction, real exposure threshold, oxygen-consumption rate or BVAD value is implemented.

scienceCards.fact: NASA's Veggie garden on the International Space Station uses plant pillows to help balance water, nutrients and air around roots, and LEDs for light.
scienceCards.boundary: Veggie is an ISS experiment, not an operating lunar farm. No crop harvest time or consumption figure is presented as NASA data.

scienceCards.fact: NASA monitors space radiation and uses dosimeters to measure exposure.
scienceCards.boundary: No electromagnetic shield, guaranteed protection, radiation dose conversion or invented risk percentage.

scienceCards.fact: NASA's lunar relay plans aim to support communication where Earth is not directly visible, including the lunar South Pole. LunaNet includes delay/disruption-tolerant networking, which can store data until a link is available.
scienceCards.boundary: The game's relay is a training scenario, not a claim that a particular satellite or Gateway is in service. No 45-minute Moon delay.

disclosure: Educational prototype. Concept and direction: Diego and Lya. AI-assisted implementation, explanatory text, and rule proposals reviewed and approved by the team. The original DONKI event is not AI-generated. All fictional resource levels, outcomes and scene transitions are educational game rules, not NASA measurements, medical advice or operational guidance. No NASA endorsement.
